# 24-output LSTM, day-ahead: validation (generated by `scripts/run_dayahead_lstm24.py`; part P2 (c) of the completion batch)

Git commit `a8c0a6a092`. One network per day with 24 outputs; same (day, hour) samples as the other day-ahead models (4,367); training origins 828, evaluation origins 182. 30 random trials; selection and early stopping on validation (mildly optimistic).

| model | validation MAE (MW) |
|---|---:|
| 24-output LSTM | 3,670 |
| LSTM L4, pooled single-output (day-ahead model) | 3,867 |
| XGBoost S4, pooled (day-ahead model) | 3,585 |
| ridge (day-ahead model) | 3,799 |

Selected: hidden 64, lr 0.001177, dropout 0.04, weight decay 0.00021; best epochs [21, 13, 13].

Run time 528 s.
